tools.name: format_json
tools.description: Validate JSON and pretty-print or minify it, optionally sorting object keys. Returns the error position for invalid JSON.

tools.name: generate_qr_code
tools.description: Make a static QR code for a link or text (up to 800 bytes). Returns a PNG image and the SVG markup. Static codes never expire.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between units of the same category. Units (symbol or name): length: m, km, mi, ft, in, cm, mm, yd, nmi; weight: kg, g, lb, oz, t, mg, st; temperature: °C, °F, K; volume: L, mL, gal, fl oz, cup, tbsp, m³; speed: km/h, mph, m/s, kn, ft/s; area: m², km², mi², ft², ac, ha; data: B, KB, M

tools.name: generate_password
tools.description: Generate random passwords with a cryptographically secure generator. Each chosen character set appears at least once.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: Hash UTF-8 text with MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 or SHA-512 and return the hex digest. MD5 and SHA-1 are for checksums only, not security.

tools.name: base64
tools.description: Encode UTF-8 text to Base64 (standard or URL-safe) or decode Base64 back to text.

tools.name: test_regex
tools.description: Run a JavaScript regular expression against text and list every match with its position and capture groups (up to 200 matches, 0.5 s limit).

tools.name: convert_timestamp
tools.description: Convert a Unix timestamp (seconds or milliseconds) or a date string to Unix seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601, UTC and a chosen time zone.

tools.name: count_words
tools.description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in text, with an estimated reading time.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "generate_password" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Generate random passwords with a cryptographically secure generator. Each chosen character set appears at least once.
